recognize_zh: 骨髓中大量紅血球前驅細胞體積變大、染色質呈篩網狀開放而細胞質已深藍或偏粉紅（核質發育不同步），並見多核紅血球母細胞與核呈馬蹄形的巨大後骨髓細胞（giant metamyelocyte，箭頭與插圖），是巨母紅血球性造血的典型表現。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with marked erythroid hyperplasia composed of enlarged erythroblasts
Erythroid precursors with open, sieve-like (stippled) chromatin disproportionate to cytoplasmic maturation (nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony)
Deeply basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm in erythroblasts; occasional multinucleated erythroblast
Giant metamyelocytes/bands with large horseshoe-shaped nuclei and fine granular cytoplasm (arrows, inset)
Background of macrocytic red cells and scattered granulocytic cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular specimen with marked erythroid hyperplasia. The erythroid precursors are enlarged with open, finely stippled sieve-like chromatin and relatively mature cytoplasm, reflecting nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony; a multinucleated erythroblast is present. Giant metamyelocytes with large horseshoe-shaped nuclei are also seen (arrows and inset). No increase in blasts or abnormal infiltrate is evident. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic hematopoiesis, in keeping with vitamin B12 and folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: MDS may show megaloblastoid erythroids but also has ring sideroblasts, hypolobated/hypogranular neutrophils or dysplastic megakaryocytes and does not correct with vitamin replacement.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows >80% erythroid cells with >=30% proerythroblasts, highly atypical and often TP53-mutated, rather than a full maturation spectrum.
Morphology is identical; drug history and normal B12/folate levels distinguish it.
